fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled checkpoint found. The property has only a low post-and-cable boundary marker along the road (clear in Street View 2024-02) — no security fence, no barrier arm and no guard booth across the truck driveway. The access road off Florence Harllee Blvd reads as an uncontrolled industrial driveway. Classified false; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed-booth structure anywhere at the entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A single very long dock bank runs the full ~500ft south face of the 502,320 sq ft building, with trailers backed in along its whole length. Estimate ~70 doors from z18 imagery — 50+ band confident.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A long row of marked trailer-parking stalls south of the dock apron holds many trailers without tractors; combined with the dock-backed trailers, the yard reads 50+. Dedicated drop area present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors are on one continuous face; ship and receive appear to share the same dock bank — not separate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and broad apron with substantial unused paved width leave clear room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved yard between the access road and the dock doors provides internal post-gate staging room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Pee Dee Touchstone Energy Commerce Park on the edge of Florence, surrounded by woods, fields and retention ponds — Rural setting.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~42 acres derived from the perimeter box covering the full building footprint, dock apron and trailer-stall rows.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property in any imagery.
